attempts.text:
Only Thakre shelter is a usable drop-off. Tarkeshwar hospital can't be reached, because every road into it is washed out or flooded. From Thakre, the car can reach only Gajuri (7 min) and Myagang (24 min). Likhu farm and Panchakanya care home are cut off from Thakre, so those people have to be deferred.

- **Gajuri widow:** a 14-minute round trip beats the 50 penalty, so she is rescued.
- **Myagang grandmother:** a 48-minute round trip beats the 50 penalty, so she is rescued.
- **Deferred:**
  - Panchakanya: 2 injured (160) and 1 elderly (50).
  - Likhu: 7 adults (140).

Driving is 7+7+24+24 = 62 minutes. Penalties are 160+50+140 = 350.

<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter gajuri-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 gajuri-care-home thakre-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
drive car1 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 myagang-care-home thakre-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
defer panchakanya-care-home injured 2
defer panchakanya-care-home elderly 1
defer likhu-farm adult 7
</plan>

COST: 412
